edition_angle: Endothelial-derived soluble signals act as systemic aging factors, targeting collagen-rich interstitial microenvironments to drive age-related sarcopenia.

assignments.angle: Endothelial cell-released soluble Dll4 accumulates in collagen-rich tissue space to drive Notch2-mediated sarcopenia and vascular regression.
assignments.reason: This primary preprint identifies a clear molecular and physiological mechanism (endothelium-secreted Dll4 binding type I collagen and activating Notch2) driving both primary and secondary sarcopenia. It directly addresses muscle aging (Cell Shedding/Inner Garden domain) and presents a actionable therapeutic target via Dll4 inhibition.
